description: This file contains the implementation of the calling logic for Databricks embeddings within the litellm project. It defines a class `DatabricksEmbeddingHandler` that inherits from external and internal base classes, and primarily implements the `embedding` method to validate environment variables and delegate the call to a superclass method.
